syntheticConversations.prompt: Runtime test: explain in two short sentences what a thermometer measures.
En una frase, explica por favor lo que mide un termometro.
syntheticConversations.answer: Un termometro mide la temperatura de un cuerpo. Es comúnmente usado para medir el calentamiento corporal, lo que puede ayudar a determinar si una persona está enferma o no.
syntheticConversations.qualityNote: A runtime smoke test only. Temperature alone does not determine whether someone is ill; the generated phrasing is overbroad.

syntheticConversations.prompt: Runtime test: in one short sentence, what does a pulse count measure?
syntheticConversations.answer: A pulse count measures the number of times your heart beats per minute.

safariAppCloseReopen.userAction: Owner was asked to close Safari from the iPhone app switcher, reopen it, and return to Kit while keeping Airplane Mode on and Wi-Fi off. Owner replied: just closed and reopened it.
